Artificial Intelligence Intern

Yangtze Delta National Innovation Ultrasonic (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.

Location

China (Shanghai, Shanghai)

No. of Opening(s)

4

Stipend

RMB225 per day

Apply by

30 Sep 2026

Internship Period

2026-10-01 - 2027-04-01

Industry

Education Level(s)

Education Level(s)

Job Description

  1. Development of large model (LLM) application scenarios;
  2. AI-based intelligent diagnosis for ultrasound medical imaging.

Internship Requirements

Master’s degree or graduated bachelor’s degree students; internship period of no less than six months, with good Chinese listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills, and meeting at least one of the following requirements:

  1. Major in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Medical Imaging, Biomedical Engineering, Electronic Information, Automation, Mathematics, or related fields.
  2. Solid programming foundation, proficient in Python, with an understanding of common data structures, algorithms, and engineering development workflows.
  3. Familiar with the fundamental theories of deep learning, and proficient in at least one mainstream framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  4. Strong ability in literature review, problem analysis, and experiment reproduction, capable of independently advancing algorithm validation or application development tasks.

Other Benefits and Welfare

About the Company

在长三角一体化上升为国家战略的时代背景下，长三角国创超声（上海）有限公司于 2023 年正式成立 ，并于2024年获得上海张江集团战略投资，企业致力于先进超声技术的研发和应用。公司已构建工业智能监测设备、超声诊疗合一设备、能源环保设备三大产品体系，提供软硬件协同、AI 算法训练推理及平台级声纹库处理的应用和产品，形成覆盖工业设备健康监测、化纤生产监测清洗、智慧水务监测管理、海洋作业监测维保等领域的行业解决方案。 公司围绕 “超声诊疗合一”” 智能声学安全监测 “”超声先进制造” 三大领域，已申报超 100 项知识产权，成立鲲雷智能、声爱医疗等 4 家子企业。以 “引领超声技术前沿，践行科创兴国使命” 为愿景，国创超声致力于成为全球一流超声技术企业，为长三角新兴产业注入新质生产力。
